RAW_UNIVERSE.trace_timing: Immediately after input normalization and before per-date/per-symbol filtering.

ELIGIBILITY_FILTER.trace_timing: After the per-symbol candidate record contains final eligibility fields, before ranked selection.

PRE_RANK_CANDIDATE_SNAPSHOT.trace_timing: After all eligibility filtering and before any in-place sort, sorted call, slice, or TopN truncation.

RANKED_CANDIDATE_SNAPSHOT.trace_timing: After exact legacy ordering is complete and before candidate_top_n or entry_top_n truncation.

TOP3_ENTRY_SELECTION.trace_timing: After exact legacy TopN selection and before position sizing or order creation.

EXISTING_HOLDINGS_SEPARATION.trace_timing: Capture existing holding symbols before removing or skipping them from new-entry candidates.

PRE_GATE_INTENT_HANDOFF.trace_timing: Capture candidate decisions before market_entry_allowed blocks downstream entry.

POSITION_SIZING_BOUNDARY.trace_timing: The candidate trace must be complete before shares, weight, or cash allocation is calculated.

PENDING_ORDER_BOUNDARY.trace_timing: Candidate and selection traces must be finalized before pending order append/update.

instrumentation_rules: Instrumentation must be disabled by default.
Trace collection must be guarded by an explicit read-only callback or trace sink.
No trace code may sort, append, pop, remove, update, or otherwise mutate strategy collections.
Trace snapshots must use tuple copies and shallow dict copies only at proven stable boundaries.
Trace code may not call strategy functions again.
Trace code may not consume generators or iterators.
Trace code may not alter logger levels, random state, dates, pending orders, cash, holdings, or signals.
Trace output must be written after snapshot creation and outside strategy condition expressions.
A no-trace run and trace-enabled run must produce byte-identical strategy result JSON.
